note: Bundled files that ship no sourcemap, so scripts/third-party-notices.ts cannot see code inlined in them. Each was checked by hand. `packages`: the package ships no sourcemaps at all and has no dependencies of its own to inline (env-paths depends on is-safe-filename, which is bundled and listed separately). `files`: a map-less file inside a package whose other files have sourcemaps; written as package/path-inside-the-package. Anything not listed here fails the release build.
